sources.title: Idaho Session Laws 2025, chapter 122 (Senate Bill No. 1015, Sixty-eighth Legislature, First Regular Session, as enacted) — "RELATING TO HOSPITALS AND HOME HEALTH AGENCIES"
sources.source_date: the bill's own SECTION 46 declares an emergency and states the act "shall be in full force and effect on and after July 1, 2025"; enacted as 2025 Session Laws chapter 122 per the History lines on the codified sections in Source 2
sources.notes: The enrolled Senate Bill 1015 PDF, captured whole as the hand capture was (pdftotext -layout, appended in full): the served document is the source the packet holds, so no slice. The 2026-09-02 capture came through the session fetch tool; plain curl with a browser user-agent reaches it (2026-09-22).

sources.title: Idaho Code Title 39, Chapter 13 (Hospitals), sections 39-1301 (Definitions), 39-1302 (Streamlined Facilities Licensing and Inspection Act — Short Title), 39-1303 (Licensure), 39-1304 (Denial or Revocation), 39-1305 (Inspections), and 39-1309 (Deemed Status of Hospice Agency)
sources.notes: One packet source published as six pages, one per Idaho Code section, in the order the standing packet holds them (FA-D-20260922-02, which added `urls` for this source rather than renumbering the page's citations). Each page is extracted on its own under div.pgbrk, the Legislature's own container for the section text (heading, body and History line; the site navigation sits outside it), and the six are joined under capture.py's page markers. Sections 39-1306 to 39-1308 are not captured, per the packet's pending list (license enforcement only). The Legislature sets section cross-references as links, so a cross-reference such as '39-1309' arrives on its own line, as it did in the hand capture.

sources.title: IDAPA 16.03.26, "Medicaid Plan Benefits" (Idaho Department of Health and Welfare, Division of Medicaid) — excerpt: cover page, rules 000-003, the chapter's "Facility" definition, and the complete Nursing Facilities (NF) sub-area, sections 470-499
sources.source_date: each rule paragraph in the source is dated "(7-1-26)" (i.e. effective July 1, 2026), the chapter's own per-paragraph amendment-date convention

slice.from: IDAPA 16 – IDAHO DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH AND WELFARE Division of Medicaid

sources.notes: A 190-page chapter. The standing packet held four discontiguous excerpts (cover page, rules 000-003, the section 010 'Facility' definition, and rules 470-499, the complete Nursing Facilities sub-area); a slice takes one span, so this captures the contiguous superset from the cover page's first line to the end of rule 496-499, stopping at rule 500's capitalised body heading. A superset can only add evidence. The to-anchor carries rule 501's heading too, so that it matches the body and never the title-case table of contents ('500. (Reserved)'). The chapter dates each paragraph '(7-1-26)'; a rule amended later changes those dates in place, which reads as drift.
